evidence.title: Treasury sanctions 17 tankers linked to Iran's 'shadow fleet' in economic pressure campaign

occurrences.checkable_against: Subsequent Iranian economic data and U.S. Treasury sanctions announcement
occurrences.quote_span: And though the specific action announced Thursday is not expected to cause massive changes in Iran's economy on its own, Treasury said it is targeting the "remnants" of Iran's shadow fleet to complement existing sanctions aimed at limiting Iran's ability to attack vessels in the Strait of Hormuz and sustain its regime.

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Treasury vessel sanctions record for TINA 5 and August 2026 cargo records
occurrences.quote_span: The vessels targeted include the Vanuatu-flagged TINA 5, which Treasury says transported over 1.5 million barrels of Iranian crude in August; the Comoros-flagged LPG tanker SOGL, which Treasury says has moved more than two million barrels of Iranian propane and butane since September 2025; and the Cameroon-flagged crude oil tanker SHENZHEN, which Treasury says has moved more than 3.5 million barrels of Iranian crude oil since November 2025.

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Treasury vessel designation list and press release dated October 8, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: The new vessels being sanctioned are registered under more than a dozen jurisdictions, and Treasury said in a press release they are responsible for the transport of millions of barrels of Iranian crude, petroleum and petrochemical products.
occurrences.speaker: U.S. Treasury Department
occurrences.subject: U.S. Treasury sanctions on Iran-linked vessels

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent accompanying the October 8, 2026 sanctions
occurrences.quote_span: "Treasury is starving the tyrannical regime in Tehran of the money it uses to wage war in the region, and we will continue exposing those who enable the regime's oil sales," Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a statement.
